evals.prompt: Find open Jira tickets for project ENG.
evals.expected_output: A precise Atlassian CLI preflight blocker reports whether the executable or Jira authentication is unavailable and states that no Jira command was attempted.
expectations: Run acli --version and acli jira auth status before project discovery; if either preflight gate fails, stop with the exact blocker and do not search.
If preflight succeeds, verify ENG and use a finite workitem search with explicit fields, --limit, and --json; never choose an unrelated project or disclose secrets.

evals.prompt: Show me the current details and comments for ENG-42.
evals.expected_output: A precise Atlassian CLI preflight blocker reports whether the executable or Jira authentication is unavailable and states that no Jira command was attempted.
expectations: Run acli --version and acli jira auth status before reading ENG-42; a failed gate stops all Jira reads.
After a successful gate, verify the site/account, project ownership, and issue key, then request only documented fields and comments; do not invent identity or response fields.

evals.prompt: Triage this error: payment timeout on checkout.
evals.expected_output: A precise Atlassian CLI preflight blocker reports whether the executable or Jira authentication is unavailable and states that no Jira command was attempted.
expectations: Do not claim a candidate, duplicate, root cause, comment, or create until CLI authentication and target ownership are verified.
After a successful gate, use bounded searches and fresh issue reads, report evidence and confidence, and keep triage read-only unless a separate exact write is confirmed.

evals.prompt: Create a medium-priority bug for checkout timing out in ENG.

After a successful gate, verify project/type/required fields and bounded duplicate evidence, show an exact one-ticket preview, require confirmation, and re-read the returned key before reporting success.
Never invent an idempotency field or blindly retry an uncertain create.
